apps.name: Super Mario Sunshine

Achievements: strings in its binaries (2026-10-29), ReXGlue runtime with achievement toasts and overlay; where it keeps the unlocks not verified. Not seen in played installs (2026-10-30): no .gpd or other achievement file in the app folder or AppData.

apps.name: Kirby's Return to Dream Land
apps.source: README.md in the release: double-click KirbyWiiRecomp.exe; its launcher extracts the disc and starts the game. KirbyRecomp.exe is not documented. User data: KirbyWiiRecomp.exe passes Dolphin a user folder under %LOCALAPPDATA%\kirby-wii-recomp; no documented portable mode. Achievements: none in the recomp. Checked 2026-10-30: its binaries only carry Dolphin's RetroAchievements folder and .ini names, no RetroAchievements server or client, so nothing unlocks while playing it (the original is RetroAchievements game 104, which only counts what is earned in emulators).
